operations.title: 1250 — The Five-Cycle Canonical Function Has Thirty-Six Free Cyclic Seeds
operations.body: The 180 source-authorized terms form 36 free C5 orbits. The canonical function is exactly the common prefactor times 36 labelled Reynolds orbit sums. Entry 1200 profiles split as 14+20+2 seeds. This reduces compilation fivefold without quotienting occurrence or deck labels.

operations.title: Benincasa compresses the source five-cycle period to 36 cyclic seeds
operations.body: Entry 1250: the 180 authorized OFPT terms decompose into 36 free C5 orbits, profilewise 14+20+2. The canonical function can be compiled from 36 seeds followed by labelled cyclic Reynolds sums; this retains all occurrence and C2^5 deck labels. Next gate is the smallest deck-character block containing the physical orbit sum on the multi-Kummer cover.
